meta.notes: D1 and D2 are both quadcopters, so we keep D2 on standby to meet the rule of having one quadcopter on standby. G1 is the only rover and can carry the heaviest payload, so it is assigned to T6 and T9. M1 and M2 are both mobile manipulators and can carry the robotic arm, so they are assigned to tasks that require it. D1 is assigned to tasks that can be done on the roof or require a camera.
